_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.

elements.desc: a 300 px paper header over the whole reel: 2 px ink rule, 48 px title (the reel's topic in the speaker's words) flush left, the chapter counter «00 / 05» flush right; a 4 px signal-red line under it strikes across on frame 0 (linear)
the speaker's plate as shot, full frame, between the header and a paper page that starts 40 px under the head box (on the 24 px baseline); column guides on header and page only, never across the face

the speaker's words set flush left on a column start, a grey 60 px lead-in + a 104 px Bold statement (cards 112 px); each word rises out of its clip rect on its spoken onset in a sixteenth with cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1), leaves upward in an eighth
a poster card = the page's top edge wiping up over the frame (an eighth); it rolls up into the header after its last word, uncovering the next world from the bottom; never a fade
chapter card: the statement on top, a ~700 px Inter 800 numeral optically flush left at the bottom, climbing in 4 eased steps, thunk on landing; a caption row under it
the protagonist as a signal-red slab (3 columns x 940 px) wiping up on the word that names it, the speaker's words overprint it in black
the named book as an artifact on the grid: the real cover in greyscale on columns 5-6, a museum label (author, title) on columns 1-4, then the statement
a spoken list: each row set with a red badge, knife-cut after the speaker names it; two slots, a cut row frees its slot
the cut to the tight plate: the page top re-flows to the new chin line in an eighth (push into one module)
the line that announces the steps: the column guides grow, four outlined modules 02-05 are ruled (four lines each, linear)
the steps as ruled rows on the page: a rule grows, the grey number, the speaker's word in Bold; the header counter swaps on each word
the line about effort or doubt: a black bar flush on the grid slides past the page edge (bleed) on the doubt word, then snaps back flush on the resolution word

the grid means something: 6 x 10 cells = the 60 minutes of an hour; red (the protagonist) fills every cell in a ripple, a knife clears them nearest-first, the named activities snap in as labelled black bars, the protagonist keeps one cell

the red module (the protagonist) leaves the grid linearly and unsnapped with one eighth pause on the turn word; the caption row readout turns from 'on grid' to red 'off grid'; flat end on the last word

ideas_not_built_yet: rotate 90 degrees and stop (the same thing read another way): rotate a card, hold, then label
pull out to a wall of artifacts (one programme, many outputs) for a reel that lists many items
a vertical scroll through a column (a manifesto or spec sheet)
split frame into equal cells with the speaker's face in one cell (needs a matte or a second take)
the speaker's words behind the head with the matte (step-deck's trick) for the giant numeral on a face world
a frame-accurate running counter in the caption row (the demo's bar counter)
